name: @nivo-lite/blocks-core
description: All of Nivo's business on the agent SDK: the generic blocks and graph nodes, each module's declaration and template (./modules/<module>) and the registry that lists them (./modules), every one made with defineBlock, defineNode or the module types of @nivo-lite/agent-sdk. The root export and ./modules are React-free for the back end; ./client holds the Grammar-only block components and ./client/loyalty the Loyalty workbench until its spec draws it.
